name: Saredutant
summary: Saredutant (SR-48,968) is a drug that acts as a NK2 receptor antagonist. It was under development by Sanofi-Aventis as a novel antidepressant and anxiolytic and made it to phase III clinical trials. However, in May 2009, Sanofi-Aventis published its quarterly results and announced the cessation of 14 research/development projects, among which was saredutant for the treatment of major depressive disorder.

pharmacology.text: Saredutant (SR-48,968) is a drug that acts as a NK2 receptor antagonist.

uses.text: It was under development by Sanofi-Aventis as a novel antidepressant and anxiolytic and made it to phase III clinical trials.

fact.en: Saredutant blocks the NK2 receptor, which responds to neurokinin A, one of the substance P family of peptides. Trials of such drugs for depression have been disappointing.
fact.zh: Saredutant 阻斷 NK2 受體，這個受體會對神經激素 A 起反應，而後者屬於 P 物質胜肽家族。這類藥物用於憂鬱症的試驗結果令人失望。
